title: Text responses without ads
summary:
Ads were removed from text responses, while the image editor and API Reference got a little easier to navigate.

The text API’s ad system was disabled for regular and streaming responses. Streaming now passes through without the ad wrapper changing it.

The image editor moved Reference Images next to the prompt controls, enlarged thumbnails, and made the add and remove controls clearer.

Documentation links and the page title now use “API Reference” consistently. Header and FAQ buttons also got a visual cleanup.
